104: Is that to say that there are none that are disqualified by years? - Aren't there the Passover offering and the sin offering, by which is written "within their first year"? When is "bah" needed to exclude something from being disqualified by labor? It is for [these cases], for if they were not excluded [with "bah"], it would have been derived [that labor does disqualify them] using an a fortiori inference from the heifer [whose neck is broken].
